messages:
AlertBot: [ALERT] p99 latency spike for model 'redwood-xl-1.2' in us-west-2 — 13:02 UTC. Threshold breached for 5m. link: https://ops.redwood/investigations/INC-4672
Alex O'Neill: seeing this too — p95 up ~1800ms, p99 ~4200ms. No config rollouts in last 30m AFAIK. alert graph shows tail correlates with a handful of heavy embedding jobs.
Priya Sharma: noted. Any customer tickets? could be one client sending long contexts. If we need fast mitigation: 1) enable circuit breaker for long requests 2) route requests from noisy API keys to fallback smaller model 3) temporary rate-limit tighten.
Customer Support: we have 1 escalated ticket (CS-881) — customer repro: POST /v1/generate with `max_tokens: 8192` + streaming on a loop. They attached request examples.
Mateo Ruiz: copy. I'm going to trigger immediate fallback routing for that API key to `redwood-xl-1.2-qa-quant` (quantized variant) and lower concurrency to 2 for that pool. Running command:
```
# route key -> fallback model
rctl route update --key=acct_42XYZ --fallback-model=redwood-xl-1.2-quant --max-concurrency=2
```
Alex O'Neill: good. Also enable the circuit breaker threshold at token latency + rate: set `p99_tokens > 4000 -> open` for 60s, then half-open. Example policy in console:
```
circuit_breakers:
  - name: long-tail-requests
    trigger: request.tokens >= 4096 and replica.latency.p99 >= 3000
    action: return 429
    cooldown: 60s
```
Priya Sharma: I'll push a temporary rate-limit override for free-tier, tighten burst window for all keys to prevent amplification. Setting: `requests_per_minute` -> 120 (was 600).
Jin Park: FYI infra autoscaler shows pool us-west-2/xlarge saturated on single AZ. Scaling group is pending a warm-up. To stop tail, we can: 1) add 2 more xlarge instances to the pool (fast) 2) shift traffic to us-east-1 fallback region for non-compliant keys. Which do we want?
Mateo Ruiz: add instances first (quick), then failover noisy keys to us-east. Command: `infra scale pool redwood-xl-1.2 us-west-2 +2 --priority=high`
```
# quick scale
infra scale pool redwood-xl-1.2 us-west-2 2 --force
```
Customer Support: repro attached — looped streaming client that restarts on non-200; they were hitting us-west-2 exclusively.
Alex O'Neill: action plan: (A) Mateo adds fallback routing for acct_42XYZ -> quant model (done) (B) Jin scales pool + monitors warm-up (in progress) (C) Priya tightens rate limits + enable circuit breaker (doing) (D) CS to contact customer with best-practices (done) — keep me posted if p99 dips below 1200ms.
Priya Sharma: deployed circuit breaker rule and rate-limit change. Watching metrics. :eyes:
Jin Park: infra scaled +2 instances, one AZ warmed, spreading load. p95 dropped to ~620ms, p99 down to ~1500ms and trending.
Alex O'Neill: nice. For postmortem: we should add an automated guardrail that 1) marks API keys that cause >3x normal request sizes and 2) auto-routes them to quantized model after 2 breaches in 10m. Also add an alert that ties p99 increases to top K API keys by token usage.
Mateo Ruiz: I'll add a short config PR for auto-route heuristics and include a test harness to simulate noisy clients.
Customer Support: customer acknowledged rollback of their abusive client loop; asked for our recommended limits and persisted fallback.
Alex O'Neill: closing thread when p99 < 1000ms for 10m and escalation ticket updated. Thanks team :rocket:
